biotools.summary: Membrane Protein-Lipid Interaction Database. A large-scale experimentally validated dataset of 80685 residue-level lipid contact annotations across 4712 membrane proteins derived from PDB crystal and cryo-EM structures. Provides pre-computed binary contact labels, continuous distance values, sequence-identity-based cluster assignments, and ready-made train-validation-test splits for machine learning.
